MODEL POLICY

Lantern Registry Act.

Section 1 (Title):

This act shall be known as the Synthetic Lantern Registry Act.

Section 2 (Purpose):

This act keeps an invented list of lanterns current.

Section 3 (Provisions):

a) (Definitions)

i) “Lantern” means a portable lamp kept under [insert the state’s lamp code].

ii) “Registrar” means the [Secretary of State].

b) (Registration)

i) A keeper shall register each lantern within [X DAYS] of acquiring it.
ii) The registrar shall publish the list each year.

c) The provisions of this act are severable.
